title: 新闻事实细节题
goal: 定位具体事实并核对人物、地点、时间和数量。

points.label: 听出题干所问的具体事实
将事实对应到正确的人物和阶段

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 事实细节题询问报道中的具体信息。题干可以询问人物行为、地点、时间或数量。

body.box: Who designed the sign? / Where was the sign placed? / When was it installed? / How many signs were installed?

body.p: 一条报道常有几个人物、几个阶段。答案的行动和对象都要与题干一致。

steps.d: who 问人物，where 问地点，when 问时间，how many 问数量。The guide opened the door 回答的是行动者。
将动作与执行者、对象相连。The guide opened the door 中，guide 是执行者。
核对时间或数量属于哪个动作。The doors arrived Monday and opened Tuesday 中，开放时间是 Tuesday。
正确选项常改写原文的说法。重复了原词、但换了做事的人或事件的选项，与原文不符。

cards.title: 细节类别
rows: Staff arranged the chairs; volunteers opened the doors.
The manager ordered the maps; a printer produced them.
The talk moved to the hall; the display stayed in the library.
The market is beside the station; the office is opposite the park.
Tickets arrived Monday; sales began Tuesday.
Work started in May and ended in June.
Six guides led groups of ten.

body.box:
The town received eight benches on Monday. Volunteers installed six of them in the park on Tuesday; the other two were placed beside the library. The benches were supplied by a local workshop. The town paid for them after residents requested more places to sit. Staff checked each location before the volunteers began installation. The remaining benches were installed on Wednesday.
How many benches did volunteers install in the park?
1. Two benches
2. Six benches
3. Eight benches
4. Ten benches

body.p: installed six of them in the park 对应第二项。eight 是收到的总数，two 是图书馆旁的数量。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: Benches arrived Monday; installation began Tuesday.
Staff ordered maps; a printer produced them.
The meeting is in the hall; the display is in the library.
Six guides led groups of ten.

lines.text: The choir director chose the songs, while students designed the concert posters.

items.why: 依据是 students designed the concert posters。海报由学生设计，第二项符合。

lines.text: The science talk will take place in the museum hall. The display remains in the library.

items.stem: Where will the talk take place?
items.why: 依据是 The science talk will take place in the museum hall。第一项符合；图书馆是展览所在地。

lines.text: Workers delivered the seats on Monday and installed them on Wednesday.

items.why: 依据是 delivered the seats on Monday and installed them on Wednesday。周一送达，周三安装，相隔两天，第三项符合。

lines.text: Four teams planted eight trees in the garden during the morning.

items.why: 依据是 Four teams planted eight trees。四个队一共种了八棵树，第四项符合；four 是队数。

lines.text: A student group has opened a small exhibition on local farming in the town hall. The group collected photographs from twelve families and selected twenty images for the display. A local artist designed the posters, while the students wrote the notes beside each photograph. The exhibition opened on Monday and will remain in the hall until Friday. It will then move to the public library for the following week. The students began gathering material in January, and they completed the selection in March. Visitors can read accounts of changes in farming alongside the photographs. The group leader said the project began as a class assignment but grew when families offered more pictures. Entry is free at both locations. The students will also give a short talk at the library next Wednesday. Staff at the library have arranged seating for the talk, and a printed guide will be available at the entrance.

items.stem: Who wrote the notes beside the photographs?
items.why: 依据是 the students wrote the notes beside each photograph。第二项符合；本地艺术家设计的是海报。

items.stem: Where will the exhibition move after Friday?
items.why: 依据是 It will then move to the public library for the following week。第三项符合。

lines.text: A public garden has installed new benches along its walking path. Garden staff chose the locations, while a group of volunteers assembled the benches. The town workshop delivered ten benches on Monday, and eight were installed beside the path on Tuesday. The remaining two were placed near the garden entrance on Wednesday. The garden manager said the seats were requested by visitors who wanted places to rest during longer walks. The town paid for the materials, and the volunteers contributed their time. Staff have also put up a map showing the path and its entrances. The map is beside the visitor center, where printed copies are available. The garden is open daily, although the visitor center closes on Mondays. Later this month, the manager plans to ask visitors whether the new seating meets their needs. The garden has not announced any further changes to the walking path. Visitors can leave comments at the center throughout the week.

items.why: 依据是 a group of volunteers assembled the benches。第三项符合；工作人员选的是位置。

items.stem: Where were the remaining two benches placed?
items.why: 依据是 The remaining two were placed near the garden entrance。第一项符合。

items.stem: How many benches were installed beside the path?
items.why: 依据是 eight were installed beside the path。第四项符合；ten 是送来的总数。

lines.text: A neighborhood bakery has begun delivering bread to a community food center each Thursday. The bakery makes the bread early in the morning, and volunteers collect it at nine. The food center then distributes the bread with other groceries in the afternoon. The arrangement began this month after center staff contacted several local businesses. The bakery owner said the weekly delivery uses ingredients purchased for the project. The center already receives fresh vegetables from a nearby farm on Tuesdays, and staff store them until the next distribution. Last week, the bakery sent thirty loaves, while the farm supplied twenty boxes of vegetables. The food center is based in the old post office building near the railway station. Its manager said the new arrangement would run for three months before both organizations review it. Residents interested in helping can speak to staff at the community center during its normal opening hours.

items.stem: When do volunteers collect the bread?
items.why: 依据是 volunteers collect it at nine。面包清早烤好，志愿者九点来取，第二项符合。

items.stem: Where is the food center based?
items.why: 依据是 based in the old post office building near the railway station。第三项符合；火车站只是附近的地标。

items.stem: How many loaves did the bakery send last week?
items.why: 依据是 the bakery sent thirty loaves。第一项符合；twenty 是蔬菜的箱数。
